discord-rpc-dropped: The TS built a Discord presence client in prepareLaunch when the global discordRPC setting was on, and returned it as rpcClient. The operator decision of 2026-11-17 (the 82 amendment) deletes constructAndUpdateRPC in 88.1 and does not port it, so the Rust prepare step never builds a client and the reply carries no rpcClient. Every case here runs with discordRPC false, so no golden holds a client.
